integrity: Algebraic proof, special k=1 boundary, exact verified finite levels 1 through 6 and explicitly unproved extrapolation restriction: finite computation alone cannot establish infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Classical Fibonacci recurrence, powers of eleven, exact least-period index fibers only. Known eleven-adic value-set density 145/264 and support decomposition credited; potential hidden historical specialization in the unread 1999 frequency-bounds chapter. No extension to general Lucas recurrences.
title: Exact residue multiplicities of Fibonacci numbers modulo powers of eleven
